title: Campus Facilities and Infrastructure - KITCOEK
text:
CAMPUS FACILITIES AND INFRASTRUCTURE — KITCOEK

KIT's College of Engineering, Kolhapur is spread over an 11-hectare campus in Gokul-Shirgoan, Kolhapur with state-of-the-art infrastructure.

ACADEMIC FACILITIES
- Well-equipped laboratories for all departments (Computer, Electronics, Mechanical, Civil, Biotechnology, Electrical)
- Centralized Digital Library with access to journals, e-books, IEEE, Springer, Elsevier databases
- E-Content Development Studio for recording lectures
- Language Lab for communication skills development
- Apple Training Centre
- Mayura-AICTE Idea Lab — for innovation, prototyping, 3D printing, electronics
- Virtual Labs (collaboration with IIT Bombay's Spoken Tutorial and COEP)
- Learning Management System (LMS) for online course delivery
- NIDHI i-TBI Incubation Centre (KITE) for student startups

HOSTEL
- Separate boys and girls hostels available on campus
- Hostel fee structure available on website for AY 2025-26
- Mess/canteen facility with hygienic food
- 24x7 security and Wi-Fi

SPORTS AND FITNESS
- Cricket ground, football ground, volleyball and basketball courts
- Indoor sports facility — table tennis, chess, carrom
- Gymnasium
- Annual sports fest organized every year

OTHER FACILITIES
- Canteen on campus
- Medical/first aid room
- ATM facility on campus
- Wi-Fi enabled campus
- Transportation facility (bus service from city)
- Seminar hall and auditorium for events and conferences
- CCTV surveillance across campus

CO-CURRICULAR
- NCC (National Cadet Corps) unit
- NSS (National Service Scheme) unit
- Rotaract Club, Cultural Club, Women Development Cell, and 12+ student clubs
- Annual cultural fest (Aura)
- Technical fest organized by departments
- Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell)
